content.title: 过去将来时(would do / was going to do)速查
content.intro: 过去将来时表示'从过去某个时间点看将要发生的事'。两种主要形式:would + 动词原形、was/were going to + 动词原形。判断口诀:看主句是不是过去时(said/knew/told…),事情在当时还没发生,就用过去将来;will 是从现在看(视角错),一般过去是已发生(尚未发生时不能用)。

rows: 从过去看的将来 / 转述将来:He said he would climb Qomolangma.
过去的打算、计划(常未实现):I was going to collect water, but the storm came.
现在将来 will / be going to
从现在看的将来(对照):He says he will climb Qomolangma.(主句现在)
直接引语 will → would;be going to → was/were going to

specialRules.rule: 主句过去 + 事情当时未发生 → 用 would / was going to,不用 will
specialRules.mark: She knew the trip would be hard.(would √ / will ×)

specialRules.rule: was/were going to 常表'本打算但没做成',后面常跟 but…
specialRules.mark: We were going to put up the tent, but the wind was too strong.

specialRules.rule: be going to 后、would 后都接动词原形
specialRules.mark: was going to reach √ / was going to reached ×

specialRules.rule: 主句 knew/said 为过去,从句其他动词也相应后移
specialRules.mark: I knew a storm was coming.(was, 非 is)

why: would 是 will 的过去式、was/were going to 是 be going to 的过去式;当叙述或转述的立足点在过去时,'将来'自然要用它们的过去形式,这样时态前后才一致。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空/改错高频:主句过去时,空格表将来 → would do 或 was/were going to do,别误填 will。
区分 would do(从过去看的将来)与 was going to do(过去的打算、计划,常未实现)。
转述句中 will→would、be going to→was/were going to 的时态后移。

examVsReal.exam: He said he would come the next day.(考试/书面转述)
examVsReal.note: 考试看主句过去用 would;口语转述新鲜消息时也可保留现在时态

examVsReal.exam: I was going to call you, but I forgot.(考试)
examVsReal.real: I was gonna call you, but I forgot.
examVsReal.note: 口语里 going to 常读作 gonna,书面仍写 going to
